name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron

meta.wiki: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron

summary: In the Searing Gorge, fiery flux is running low, and Master Smith Burninate needs more. After What the Flux?, Burninate asks for scales, iron bars, and coal, and will take all you can offer.

sections.title: Fiery Flux Wanted
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux as the supply runs low. In the Searing Gorge, Burninate asks you for two incendosaur scales, four iron bars, and coal. All you can offer will be taken.

faq.answer: Master Smith Burninate asks for the goods and receives them in person in the Searing Gorge.
Burninate wants two incendosaur scales, four iron bars, and coal.
What the Flux? came before this request, and Burninate gave it to you.

faq.q: Why does Burninate want these goods?
faq.answer: Burninate says the supply of fiery flux is dwindling, so more is needed to replenish it.
